answer_1.quote: We introduce the novel generation task of faithfully reflecting updated information in text (FRUIT), where the goal is to incorporate new information into an existing piece of text... The goal is to produce the updated article.

answer_2.quote: We propose to evaluate FRUIT systems using an alternative metric, UpdateROUGE, that only considers updated sentences... We also introduce the following measurements: Unsupported Entity Tokens, Entity Precision and Recall... We provide ROUGE Fscores... We measure the Spearman rank correlation between the gold baseline results and silver baseline results.

answer_4.quote: We hired a team of 9 annotators to produce a "gold" evaluation subset of our test dataset... Annotators were shown the source article, evidence, and a marked up copy of the target article... In the second step, annotators were then asked to remove the unsupported text and minimally update the article to preserve fluency... We review a random sample of 100 of its predictions on the gold evaluation data and categorize them as either: grounded updates, ungrounded updates, or no updates.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators highlighted unsupported claims and incorrect reference labels, removed unsupported text, and minimally edited the article to preserve fluency. Model outputs were manually inspected and categorized into grounded updates, ungrounded updates, or no updates, with sub‑categories for missing content, incorrect numbers/dates, hallucinations, and distorted evidence.
